content:
ABOUT AGORA

At Agora, our mission is to transform how money moves. We believe stablecoins will underpin a new financial fabric, one that is faster, more global, and more efficient than today's siloed systems. That is why we are building AUSD and the Agora stack, a full service platform that makes issuing, managing, and integrating stablecoins seamless, whether you're a developer, fintech, or institution. With AUSD, stablecoins become programmable, composable, and ubiquitous by default.

We believe digital dollars should be a public good: trusted, accessible, and built for real-world utility. Our mission is to drive adoption through customizable, user-friendly on-ramps that make stable, dollar-based value available onchain.
We're backed by world-class investors including Paradigm and Dragonfly, and we're growing a team to reimagine how value moves online.

We're intentional about who we bring on. If you're passionate about stablecoins and want to help create more open, intuitive ways for people to engage with money, let's talk.

ABOUT THE TEAM

We bring the discipline of high-performance finance teams and the creativity of a fast-moving crypto-native startup. We're a small, mission-driven group of builders who move fast, sweat the details, and hold a high bar for excellence, in product, code, and culture.

You'll be joining a tight-knit team that values clear thinking, extreme ownership, and high-velocity decision making. We operate in short feedback loops, support one another without ego, and are deeply motivated by the opportunity to build foundational infrastructure for the future of money.

Before applying, please review our Agora Engineering Culture and Ways of Working document. It reflects how we think, operate, and hold ourselves accountable, and it's the best way to assess whether this environment is the right fit for you.

JOB SUMMARY

We're seeking a Senior Fullstack Engineer to take end-to-end ownership of features and products across the stack, from Agora interfaces to reliable backend infrastructure. You'll work closely with product, design, operations, finance, and our external partners and customers to gather requirements, prototype quickly, and ship with confidence. You have strong product taste, a bias toward MVP thinking, and you're as comfortable reasoning about user experience as you are about backend systems, API designs or database schemas. Our stack includes TypeScript, React, REST APIs, Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Grafana. This is a role where you’ll own it end to end, from the first prototype through launch, iteration, and beyond.

We value real-time collaboration and prefer candidates located close to Eastern Time, while welcoming exceptional engineers across Pacific Time through ET+2. Regardless of where you are located, your working hours will need to have a majority overlap with ET business hours.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of fullstack development experience, with 3+ years in TypeScript/Node.js and a modern frontend framework (React preferred)
  • Fluency with relational databases and SQL
  • Proven ability to ship production systems, frontend and backend, with high uptime and minimal maintenance burden
  • Strong product instincts and an eye for good design; you can work from a Figma file but you'll also push back when something doesn't feel right
  • Comfortable working directly with external partners and customers on requirements gathering, integration, and iterative feature development
  • MVP mindset: you know how to scope a milestone, ship it, learn from it, and iterate fast
  • Strong commitment to clean code principles and automated testing
  • Deep understanding of API design, versioning, documentation, and modern authentication patterns
  • Excellent communication skills and experience collaborating across product, design, and operations in remote, asynchronous environments

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in fast-paced, high-growth startup environments where you've worn many hats
  • Track record of prototyping and launching customer-facing products, not just internal tools
  • Familiarity with performance profiling, latency reduction, and service-level adherence
  • Background in designing and operating event-driven architectures
  • Expertise in Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, and Grafana
  • Passion for building tools, internal or external, that meaningfully improve how people work with money
  • Hands-on experience building in crypto, including working with onchain libraries and services, and integrating with blockchain infrastructure
  • Experience integrating or interacting with blockchain node software (e.g., Geth, Solana validators)

Agora operates a centralized USD-pegged stablecoin platform with robust compliance, security, and governance. We are equally committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace.

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related conditions), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

JOB SUMMARY

We're looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to design and build Agora's internal platform that empowers product teams to ship software with confidence, reliability, and speed. This role brings a Software Engineering mindset to infrastructure: building reusable abstractions, internal services, developer tooling, and infrastructure primitives that reduce cognitive load for application teams and the Infrastructure team itself.

You will own core platform components such as our TypeScript Pulumi codebase, Kubernetes-based runtime environments, and monitoring stack. The work centers on architecting scalable systems, enforcing engineering standards through code, and continuously improving developer experience through well-engineered platform capabilities.

We value real-time collaboration and prefer candidates located close to Eastern Time, while welcoming exceptional engineers across Pacific Time through ET+2. Regardless of where you are located, your working hours will need to have a majority overlap with ET business hours.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
  • 5+ years of professional Software Engineering experience, including substantial work in Infrastructure and Cloud domains
  • Strong programming skills in TypeScript or another strictly typed language
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems fundamentals (availability, consistency, observability, fault tolerance)
  • Experience designing and maintaining infrastructure-as-code systems
  • Deep understanding of AWS architecture
  • Experience designing, operating, and scaling Kubernetes workloads
  • Proven ability to build reusable systems and abstractions rather than one-off scripts

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Experience defining SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, and building incident tooling
  • Experience improving Observability practices, defining alerts, operational dashboards and business metrics
  • Familiarity with GitOps patterns and deployment automation technologies
  • Expertise in DevEx or Developer Productivity
  • Experience building Internal Development Platforms with focus on self-service and golden paths
  • Experience in maintenance and operations of production-grade systems and on-call rotations

You'll be joining a tight-knit team that values clear thinking, extreme ownership, and high-velocity decision making. We operate in short feedback loops, support one another without ego, and are deeply motivated by the opportunity to build foundational infrastructure for the future of money.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As our Founding Data Lead, you'll build the analytics function from zero. You'll own the numbers the company runs on: how we define them, where they come from, and what they mean. High autonomy, high visibility, every part of the business.

You'll map data across our stack (onchain, product, financial, operational) into a coherent picture and tell the story of how Agora runs. Customer understanding is where you'll create the most leverage. You'll turn raw behavior into the insights that shape how we grow, where we invest, and what we build next.

You'll stand up self-service analytics so every team moves faster on its own, partner with engineering to raise the ceiling on what our data can do, and bring product analytics to life across the surfaces that matter.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data engineering, ideally as an early data hire at a high-growth startup.
  • Strong SQL. You can write complex queries across joins, window functions, CTEs, and subqueries without thinking twice.
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and metrics frameworks (Metabase, Looker, or similar).
  • Ability to translate messy business context into clean data models.
  • Comfort working with high-volume event data and the tooling to process it efficiently (Spark, Databricks, ClickHouse, or similar).
  • Clear communication. You can present findings to an exec team and make data-driven recommendations that stick.
  • Working knowledge of data orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or similar).
  • Proficiency with a product analytics platform (Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog, Heap, or similar).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with blockchain data: onchain indexing, subgraphs, multi-chain analytics, or DeFi protocols.
  • Background in fintech, payments, or financial services.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You'll be joining a tight-knit team that values clear thinking, extreme ownership, and high-velocity decision making. We operate in short feedback loops, support one another without ego, and are deeply motivated by the opportunity to build foundational infrastructure for the future of money.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a PM to own a meaningful slice of Agora's product surface and drive it forward independently. You'll set strategy, write the spec, ship it with engineering, then watch how customers actually use what you built and decide what to do next.

Agora's customers are developers, fintechs, and institutions integrating AUSD and the Agora platform into their stack. Your job is to understand what they're trying to do, find the gaps between what the product offers and what they need, and close them. That means talking to customers directly. It means going deep on technical detail when the answer lives in an API or a settlement flow. And it means partnering with BD on the strategic accounts where product feedback and revenue intersect.

In a typical week you might set the roadmap for your area, run research calls with prospects and active customers, pull your own queries to find where customers drop off, define the metric that tells you whether what you shipped worked, partner with BD on a strategic account, or write a spec and ship it with engineering.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years in product management in stablecoins, payments, or fintech.
  • Serious UX craft. You can tell the difference between a flow that works and a flow that feels good. 
  • High autonomy. You go from "something feels off here" to a shipped fix without scaffolding, including writing the specs engineers build from and the updates that move decisions forward.
  • Shipped work with measurable outcomes. You've instrumented a funnel, found a drop-off, and moved the number, and you can explain exactly what you did.
  • Strong analytical instincts. You pull your own data, define your own metrics, and use them to prioritize.
  • Comfort with technical and API-driven products. You can reason about API design, read a spec, and partner credibly with engineers on infrastructure decisions.
  • AI fluency. You build with modern AI tools (prototypes, evals, internal automations) and have a sharp, opinionated view on where they help and where they don't.

ABOUT AGORA

At Agora, our mission is to transform how money moves. We believe stablecoins will underpin a new financial fabric, one that is faster, more global, and more efficient than today’s siloed systems. That is why we are building AUSD and the Agora stack, a full service platform that makes issuing, managing, and integrating stablecoins seamless – whether you’re a developer, fintech, or institution. With AUSD, stablecoins become programmable, composable, and ubiquitous by default.
We believe digital dollars should be a public good: trusted, accessible, and built for real-world utility. Our mission is to drive adoption through customizable, user-friendly on-ramps that make stable, dollar-based value available on-chain.
We’re backed by world-class investors including Paradigm and Dragonfly, and we’re growing a team to reimagine how value moves online.
We're intentional about who we bring on. If you’re passionate about stablecoins and want to help create more open, intuitive ways for people to engage with money, let’s talk.

ABOUT THE TEAM

At Agora, we bring the discipline of high-performance finance teams and the creativity of a fast-moving crypto-native startup. We’re a small, mission-driven group of builders who move fast, sweat the details, and hold a high bar for excellence — in product, code, and culture.
You’ll be joining a tight-knit team that values clear thinking, extreme ownership, and high-velocity decision making. We operate in short feedback loops, support one another without ego, and are deeply motivated by the opportunity to build foundational infrastructure for the future of money.

JOB SUMMARY
Reporting to the Director of Finance, you will lead financial planning, forecasting, strategic analysis, and management reporting activities. This role will provide forward-looking financial insights, support enterprise-wide planning and capital management activities, and partner with business leaders to drive informed decision-making. 
We are looking for someone with a high bar for excellence, strong financial and analytical capabilities, and a willingness to challenge assumptions. This is a highly visible, hands-on role with direct exposure to executive leadership and the opportunity to help shape the financial strategy of a rapidly growing financial technology company.

Key Responsibilities
  • Build and maintain consolidated financial models for the Company and its subsidiaries, including detailed forecasts for key business lines and legal entities.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and long term planning processes across the organization.
  • Lead quarterly re-forecast cycles and monthly management reporting across the organization.
  • Analyze financial and operational performance, identify key trends and variances, and provide actionable recommendations to management.
  • Conduct scenario and sensitivity analyses around key business drivers, including stablecoin circulation growth, reserve yields, and interest rate environments.
  • Develop  financial analyses to support new products, partnerships, strategic initiatives, and expansion opportunities.
  • Prepare monthly financial packages, KPI dashboards, and ad hoc analyses for senior leadership.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Accounting, Risk and Operations teams to monitor and forecast regulatory capital ratios, liquidity positions, and other key financial metrics for regulated entities.
  • Help establish scalable FP&A processes, controls, and reporting frameworks to support the company's continued growth.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • 5 - 7 years of progressive experience in FP&A, Strategic Finance, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, Consulting, or related fields, preferably within financial services, fintech, banking, or digital assets.
  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills, with the ability to build complex operating, capital, and scenario models from scratch.
  • Experience within cryptocurrency, stablecoins, payments, banking, or regulated financial services
  • Experience developing forecasts, budgets, business cases, and executive-level financial presentations.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex financial and business issues into actionable recommendations.


Agora operates a centralized USD‑pegged stablecoin platform with robust compliance, security, and governance. We are equally committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace.
We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related conditions), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.
